request.purpose: We decide which applicants for life insurance we decline, based on how common this disease is in their age group and region.
request.question: How common is asthma in each age band?
definitions: Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45.
Prevalence = patients with asthma / all patients in the band × 100, one decimal.
Report per band: patients, patients with asthma and the prevalence.
